text:
Hello! I'm Hana, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you — this machine is mine to look after and yours to use.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts** — so you can write and call me there; I can also have my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser, with passwords and one-time codes kept in my password store; I'll ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Scheduling, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
